// diagnostic

E0603

`use` target file / module not found

What

`use` target file / module not found

Why

A `use` must name a file or module that exists where the import looks for it

Fix

Correct the `use` target path or module declaration.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0603: tests/ui/battery_dependency_unmatched/stderr.

Error [jet.UseTargetNotFound]: The version dependency `web` (`9.0.0`) has no matching first-party battery
  --> tests/ui/battery_dependency_unmatched/run.jet:7:5
    |
  7 |     web
    |     ^^^
 Why: A version dependency resolves only to the toolchain's battery `Jetpack/Provider/Batteries/web`, whose package.jet declares that name and a version the selector matches
 Fix: Depend on a first-party battery by its name and version, or use a path dependency such as `./web`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0603

Error [jet.UseTargetNotFound]: The version dependency `nosuchbattery` (`0.1.0`) has no matching first-party battery
  --> tests/ui/battery_dependency_unmatched/run.jet:8:5
    |
  8 |     nosuchbattery
    |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A version dependency resolves only to the toolchain's battery `Jetpack/Provider/Batteries/nosuchbattery`, whose package.jet declares that name and a version the selector matches
 Fix: Depend on a first-party battery by its name and version, or use a path dependency such as `./nosuchbattery`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0603
